origins.description: Allowed WebSocket origins. Add every hostname or IP (with scheme and port) that clients use to open Cockpit — including any public FQDN behind a reverse proxy. Each entry is a URL string.

items.description: A single allowed origin URL, e.g. https://cockpit.example.com

protocol_header.description: Name of the HTTP header injected by an upstream reverse proxy to signal the original protocol (e.g. X-Forwarded-Proto). Leave empty if Cockpit terminates TLS directly.

forwarded_for_header.description: Name of the HTTP header carrying the real client IP address set by a reverse proxy (e.g. X-Forwarded-For). Leave empty if Cockpit is not behind a proxy.

max_startups.description: Maximum simultaneous unauthenticated connection attempts. Increase on busy servers; lower to harden against connection floods.

login_title.description: Text shown as the browser page title on the Cockpit login page. Typically set to the organisation or server name.

login_to.description: Whether to display the 'Connect to' host field on the login screen. Set to false for single-host deployments.

require_host.description: Require the operator to specify a target host before login is accepted. Useful in jump-host / gateway deployments.

allow_unencrypted.description: Allow plain HTTP access. Enable only when TLS is terminated by an upstream reverse proxy that already enforces encryption.

compression.description: Enable WebSocket per-message deflate compression. Reduces bandwidth at the cost of additional CPU. Recommended on slow or metered links.

client_cert_auth.description: Enable mutual-TLS authentication using client X.509 certificates. Requires the reverse proxy to forward the client certificate.

url_root.description: URL path prefix under which Cockpit is served (e.g. /cockpit). Required when a path-rewriting reverse proxy places Cockpit at a sub-path. Leave empty for root.

log_fatal.description: Severity level threshold written as a fatal log entry to stderr (e.g. 'criticals'). Leave empty to disable fatal-log escalation.

idle_timeout.description: Minutes of session inactivity before Cockpit forcibly terminates the session. Set to 0 to disable the idle timeout entirely.

banner_file.description: Absolute path to a plain-text file shown as a login banner before the credentials form. Leave empty to show no banner.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections Cockpit keeps open to remote managed machines. Raise for large environments; lower to conserve resources.
